summary: Preinstall downloads Bun runtime to execute a bundled obfuscated payload unrelated to the package's stated purpose
details: package.json declares `scripts.preinstall=node setup.mjs`. On `npm install`, setup.mjs downloads the Bun runtime from github.com/oven-sh/bun release archives into a temp directory, marks it executable, and invokes it against a sibling file `math_init.js` (falling back to a `bun` already on PATH). math_init.js is a ~720 KB Bun-cjs bundle (`// @bun @bun-cjs` header) using string-array rotation obfuscation (`WV8StW` rotator over a numeric-indexed array), and its contents are opaque and unrelated to the package's advertised MongoDB Atlas Functions filter purpose. setup.mjs itself is obfuscated with obfuscator.io-style identifier renaming (`_0x...` symbols, inline decoy string tables) that conceals the fetch/unzip/exec chain. The visible `dist/` library sits alongside this payload as apparent cover. The alternate-runtime dropper shape — pulling a second language runtime at preinstall solely to run a bundled obfuscated sibling — evades Node-based static review and executes attacker-controlled bytes with the installer's privileges.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
